title: How to get through the 3 p.m. slump at work
dek: The middle of the afternoon is when energy dips for many of us, and a few simple habits help more than another snack.
keywords: how to stay focused in the afternoon
body: It is three o'clock, and for many of us, focus has wandered off somewhere. The words on the screen look the same as they did an hour ago, and the snack drawer is calling.
A lot of people fight this with sugar and a second coffee. That can work for a little while and then leave you more tired, especially if you want to sleep well tonight.

Something simpler may help. Stand up and walk for five minutes, even if it is only to refill a water glass and look out a window. Drink a full glass of water. Then switch to a task that needs less deep thinking, like filing, replying to easy messages or planning tomorrow.

Saving the easy work for this part of the day lets you work with the dip instead of blaming yourself for it. If afternoon tiredness feels extreme or keeps getting worse, it is worth mentioning to a doctor.
Right now, stand up, get a glass of water and choose one small, easy task to finish before four.
